text:
maya (Product Designer): Quick design sync — Figma link in thread. Need decisions on a few Playground streaming UX bits: visual treatment while tokens stream, stop vs pause vs interrupt wording, where the token counter lives during streams, and whether prompt library should stay accessible mid-stream. PTAL

jon (Frontend): Saw the frames. Leaning toward a subtle shimmer + final message fade-in rather than hard replace. Keeps context while making it clear more is coming.

sam (Eng): Shimmer is fine, but we need to avoid layout shift for the token counter. If it jumps when the message finishes it looks janky. Suggest token counter be an overlay pill anchored to the rail.

olga (Accessibility): Overlay pill ok, but needs role="status" updates for screen readers while streaming. Also ensure the stop control is reachable via keyboard and has clear aria-label (not just "Stop").

liz (PM): Re: copy — customers confused between "Stop" and "Regenerate". Maybe label primary action "Interrupt" and secondary "Regenerate"? Thoughts on clarity for non-technical users?

maya (Product Designer): I prototyped both. "Interrupt" reads a bit technical. Alternative: "Pause" + "Regenerate". Pause implies you can resume though; we don't plan to resume stream, so that could be misleading.

jon (Frontend): Implementation note: we already emit a finalization event when stream ends. If we expose a "pause/resume" we'll need a different backend path. Prefer "Interrupt" -> emits cancel token. From a code plumbing POV "Interrupt" maps nicely.

will (ML Infra): Agreed. "Interrupt" -> cancel token is consistent with current safety fallbacks. Also worth showing a fallback small spinner on regeneration while model warms up.

olga (Accessibility): If we keep "Interrupt", add helper copy in tooltip: "Interrupt generation — partial response may be returned." Tooltip must be accessible (focusable).

sam (Eng): Token counter: propose two states: compact pill during streaming (shows tokens so far and rate), expanded after completion with token breakdown. Compact should be <40px height to avoid blocking content.

maya (Product Designer): Nice. Visual suggestion: pill with subtle progress ring around it to indicate stream progress when approximate. Avoid precise % because stream length is unknown.

jon (Frontend): Progress ring is doable — render estimated progress from length hint if model provides one, else indeterminate animation. Also we should debounce updates to the token counter to 200ms to reduce layout thrash.

liz (PM): Prompt library access: we get requests to edit prompt mid-stream. Can we allow selecting a different prompt while streaming (applies to next run) and surface a small "Switch will apply to new generation" banner?

sam (Eng): That's safe — don't mutate current run. Clicking new prompt should be disabled or greyed with a tooltip that explains it applies to next run. Alternatively, allow selection but show a confirmation toast.

maya (Product Designer): Design direction: keep prompt library accessible but non-destructive. Grey out "Apply now" during active stream; action becomes active after generation ends. Add a tiny label: "Applies to next run".

olga (Accessibility): Ensure keyboard focus order still allows opening prompt library while streaming and that focus trap in modal is respected.

jon (Frontend): I can prototype the pill + ring + debounced counter. Will also add aria-live="polite" region for streaming text updates so screen readers announce new chunks without being noisy.

will (ML Infra): Edge case: stop -> immediate fallback to smaller model occasionally returns partial tokens with different encoding counts. Need product note: token counter may change on interrupt. Add microcopy: "Token counts may change after interrupt."

maya (Product Designer): Good call. Add that to tooltip copy on the token pill. Also add microcopy under the stop button: "Interrupt returns a partial response; regenerate restarts from scratch."

liz (PM): Action items: jon prototype by EOD Wed, olga to review a11y notes once prototype ready, will to confirm cancel semantics with infra team, maya to update figma copy. I'll collect follow-ups in the PRD. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for branch playground/stream-token-pill -> staging at 2024-05-08 02:00 UTC

maya (Product Designer): Thanks team. If no blockers I'll lock direction and iterate on microcopy after a11y review.
